papers.title_en: Georeferenced Cross-View 3D Reconstruction from Ground and Satellite Images
papers.authors: David G. Shatwell, Mubarak Shah
papers.evidence: 前馈跨视角几何变换器联合预测点图、相机位姿与场景变换
papers.tldr: 从地面图像恢复三维场景时，既要重建局部几何，也要将相机与三维点定位到地理坐标系；现有跨视角定位缺少稠密重建，前馈重建又仅输出局部坐标。X-VGGT联合处理多张地面图像和带地理参考的卫星图像，预测相机位姿、稠密点图及由重力、尺度、偏航和位移构成的场景变换。该变换将局部重建投影到卫星平面，实现所有地面视图的地理配准。多种跨视角数据集实验显示其重建准确，并优于既有定位与多视图重建模型，为统一地理定位和三维重建提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Georeferenced 3D reconstruction from ground images requires recovering not only the local scene geometry, but also localizing every camera center and 3D point in a geographic coordinate frame. Existing cross-view geo-localization methods are able to estimate the GPS coordinate of a single ground camera, but do not reconstruct dense 3D geometry, while recent feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction models predict point maps and camera poses only in a local coordinate frame. We introduce X-VGGT, a feed-forward cross-view geometry transformer that unifies these tasks by jointly processing a set of ground-level images and a georeferenced satellite image to predict ground-view camera poses, dense 3D point maps, and a scene-level transform parameterized by gravity, scale, yaw and translation. This transform projects the local reconstruction into the satellite plane, resulting in the geo-registration of all ground images with the georeferenced satellite image. We further propose an evaluation protocol for this joint task and show that, across multiple cross-view datasets, X-VGGT produces accurate georeferenced reconstructions and outperforms prior cross-view geo-localization and multi-view 3D reconstruction models.

papers.title_en: DrawSplat: Atlanta World-Guided Implicit Gaussian SLAM for Indoor Reconstruction
papers.authors: Fan Zhu, Zhisong Xu, Ziyu Chen, Zhenjun Zhao, Takayuki Okatani
papers.evidence: 以结构几何引导高斯SLAM进行室内三维重建
papers.tldr: 室内RGB-D SLAM在弱纹理、大平面、深度噪声及长轨迹下，常出现位姿漂移、表面厚度伪影与边界模糊，影响跟踪和重建。DrawSplat先以点线联合跟踪估计位姿、稀疏几何和重力，再借助共享重力的亚特兰大世界先验推断结构平面，并将其约束融入高斯中心与法线。结合锚点式隐式神经高斯和自适应结构采样，实验显示其在多数据集上兼顾跟踪鲁棒性、渲染质量、几何重建、效率与模型规模，为室内重建提供更具结构一致性的方案。
papers.abstract_en: RGB-D SLAM requires accurate online tracking, high-quality rendering, and geometrically consistent reconstruction. Existing Gaussian SLAM methods mainly optimize Gaussian primitives with photometric, depth, or local frame-to-model constraints, which are often insufficient in indoor scenes with weak textures, large planar structures, noisy depth, and long trajectories. The resulting maps may suffer from pose drift, surface thickness artifacts, noisy normals, and blurred structural boundaries. We propose DrawSplat, an Atlanta World-guided implicit Gaussian SLAM framework for indoor reconstruction. DrawSplat follows a drawing-like process: explicit point-line geometry first sketches the structural layout, and implicit neural Gaussians then fill in high-fidelity appearance and continuous geometric details. It estimates camera poses, sparse geometry, and gravity direction through point-line joint tracking, infers structural planes from tracked lines using the shared-gravity component of the Atlanta World prior, and converts them into differentiable regularization terms on Gaussian centers and normals. To improve compactness and efficiency, DrawSplat further combines an anchor-based implicit neural Gaussian representation with adaptive structural sampling, which allocates Gaussian capacity to structurally informative regions. Experiments on multiple datasets show that DrawSplat achieves robust tracking, high-fidelity rendering, and strong geometric reconstruction among Gaussian-based SLAM systems, while maintaining a practical balance among quality, efficiency, and model size.

papers.title_en: When the Past Shapes Action: Understanding Embodied Memory
papers.authors: Siqi Li, Ziyi Bai, Xinrun Xu, Tinglei Huang, Börje F. Karlsson
papers.evidence: 综述具身智能体如何保存并利用交互经验
papers.tldr: 生成式基础模型推动具身智能拓展导航、操作与长时程任务能力，但动态环境中的行动不能只依赖当前观察。智能体还需保存、检索并更新过往观察、行动和经验，以支持部分信息下的决策。本文从六项记忆需求和八类架构系统梳理具身记忆，并分析其能力、局限及基准评测。综述强调，应辨别智能体是否真正利用历史信息，并指出相关挑战包括筛选经验、维护变化环境中的一致信念，以及跨情节整合知识，为构建可靠、适应性强的具身智能提供分析框架。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative foundation models have expanded the capabilities of embodied AI, enabling increasingly general navigation, manipulation, and long-horizon task execution. However, effective interaction with dynamic environments requires more than only strong perception and reasoning: agents must act with partial knowledge and retain, retrieve, and update information from past observations, actions, and experiences. This survey examines embodied memory as a mechanism for preserving decision-relevant information beyond the current observation. We organize existing approaches along two complementary dimensions: six fundamental memory requirements, spanning world-state persistence, task progress, belief maintenance, and experiential learning; and eight architectural categories, including recurrent states, fast weights, visual and symbolic representations, spatial memory, and experience-based systems. We analyze their capabilities and limitations, and examine how existing benchmarks evaluate memory-dependent behavior, distinguishing genuine use of historical information from general task performance. Finally, we identify open challenges in selecting relevant experiences, maintaining consistent beliefs in changing environments, and consolidating knowledge across episodes. Our analysis provides a framework for understanding memory as an essential component of reliable, adaptive, and lifelong-horizon embodied intelligence.

papers.title_en: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
papers.authors: Jiarui Yuan, Yuxin Zuo, Xiaoyu Huang, Wenbo Zhang, Kwanyoung Park, Junlin Yang, Tianxiang Zhang, Ruoqu Chen, Yutao Ouyang, Bingxiang He, Xingtai Lv, Hongjin Wu, Jiajun Liu, Jiahao Zhao, Tianwei Luo, Haozhan Li, Cheng Qian, Jiaxin Ge, Huan-ang Gao, Kaisen Yang, Jiaqi Deng, Qixin Xu, Siqiao Huang, Bowen Zhou, Mengdi Xu, Zhiyuan Liu, Pieter Abbeel, Ning Ding
papers.evidence: 研究机器人智能体的架构、训练能力并评测真实任务表现
papers.tldr: 机器人使用智能体已展现零样本操作潜力，但研究常受限于专有前沿模型，难以开展进一步训练。论文推出 uni-robot-agent，作为支持开放权重模型评测与训练的统一框架，并分析不同模型代际、系列和规模的能力差异。在无特权输入条件下，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 获得 31.39 分，超过已发表的 GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe 的 28.97 分，且在 19 项真实任务中表现有竞争力。研究还指出，机器人使用依赖四项通用能力，为开放模型研究和后续协同训练提供方向。
papers.abstract_en: Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training. Without privileged inputs, an out-of-the-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves a RoboDojo Score of 31.39, surpassing the published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe result of 28.97 and many VLA/WAM baselines, and performs competitively on 19 real-world tasks. Our analysis across model generations, families, and sizes links effective robot use to four general capabilities, suggesting that future RUA training should develop them jointly.

papers.title_en: TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Zhongxiang Sun, Chenghao Yang, Haojie Ding, Boheng Zhang, Fan Yang, Qingsong Wen, Kun Wang
papers.evidence: 联合评估具身智能体的物理感知、知识与推理
papers.tldr: 具身智能不仅要识别场景，还需协同感知物理状态、检索外部知识并进行定量推理；现有基准对这种能力组合评估不足。论文构建TriPhysBench，涵盖200段视频中的410道题，以测量依据和知识依据任务考查观察获取、外部规格检索及其定量应用。进一步提出TriPhys，从完整工具交互轨迹中学习统一策略，让中间推理引导检索与计算，并利用工具反馈更新物理判断。六种模型中最佳准确率仅50.38%；在未见视频问题上，TriPhys-27B较基座模型准确率相对提升17.7%，为具身物理理解提供了评测基准与训练路径。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents need physical intelligence to understand their surroundings through physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning. These capabilities must work together to interpret events and make quantitative judgments. Existing benchmarks advance physical understanding and general-purpose tool use, yet the coordination of these capabilities in physical scenarios remains insufficiently characterized. Inspired by Popper's Three Worlds, we introduce TriPhysBench, a benchmark of 410 questions from 200 videos that brings physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning into a shared evaluation setting. Its measurement-grounded and knowledge-grounded subtasks impose complementary demands on obtaining observations and acquiring external specifications, then applying them to quantitative problems. Among six representative vision-language models, the best achieves an answer accuracy of only 50.38%, revealing limited performance on tasks that require these capabilities to work together. We further introduce TriPhys, a framework that learns a unified policy for physical perception, knowledge retrieval, and quantitative reasoning from complete tool-integrated trajectories. The policy uses intermediate reasoning to guide retrieval and computation, then incorporates tool feedback into subsequent physical inference. On 110 questions from videos excluded from training, TriPhys improves answer and solution scores across three Qwen configurations, with a 17.7% relative gain in answer accuracy for TriPhys-27B over its Qwen3.6-27B backbone. This work provides a benchmark and a learning pathway toward embodied agents that move beyond recognizing events to understanding and reasoning about the physical processes behind them.

papers.title_en: Depth Anyviewpoint? Evaluating Monocular Depth Over Viewpoint Sequences
papers.authors: Theo Rode, Rui Zhang, Ryan Aubrey, Olivia Li, Jessica Huang, Liv Chu, Healani Dowd, Calden Wloka
papers.evidence: 直接评估单目图像深度估计
papers.tldr: 单目深度模型通常从单张 RGB 图像预测相对深度，近年来在单图基准上进步显著，但单帧表现难以说明模型能否在移动视角视频中维持稳定的三维结构。论文提出针对不同相机视点序列的评估协议，并在多样真实视频中借助运动恢复结构，将预测结果锚定到度量深度。评估揭示模型在长时间序列上的时间一致性仍有待改善，也发现运动恢复结构并非简单可靠的尺度参照。该工作补充了单图评测的不足，为发展可用于视频与真实场景的单目深度模型指出关键挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation aims to predict depth maps from single RGB images (forgoing the need for stereo camera pairs) and has seen impressive leaps in performance in recent work due to the introduction of affine-invariant losses and the use of foundation model features. These monocular depth models predict affine-invariant depth, which describes the relative positions of objects in the scene instead of absolute depth. While these models demonstrate strong performance on single image benchmarks and qualitatively consistent predictions in video, their effectiveness at preserving consistent spatial structure has been less thoroughly explored. Many potential real-world applications, such as handling video streams as input, rely on coherent three dimensional consistency in scenes. Further, anchoring relative depth predictions to a metric reference for a given scene is a key challenge for applying monocular depth models to real-world situations. We develop a novel evaluation protocol for monocular depth models using video sequences with moving camera positions to test the consistency of prediction across variation in viewpoint. We demonstrate this methodology over diverse, real-world video sequences where we are able to anchor depth model output to metric depth values using structure from motion. Our work demonstrates open challenges in the development of broadly applicable monocular depth foundation models, particularly with their ability to provide temporal consistency over long time frames. We also identify challenges in the straightforward adoption of structure-from-motion as a metric grounding tool for monocular depth estimation models.

papers.title_en: Gnomon4D: Learning Where and When to Focus for Geometric Motion-Grounded World-Action Modeling
papers.authors: Lingwei Dang, Yan Zhou, Juntong Li, Zhenhao Zhang, Yiteng Chen, Xiaoqiang Liu, Liang An, Hongwen Zhang, Wei Min, Guoxin Zhang, Pengfei Wan, Yebin Liu, Qingyao Wu
papers.evidence: 联合预测未来场景、机器人动作及四维几何运动
papers.tldr: 世界—动作模型预测场景变化以辅助机器人操作，但彩色视频混合了状态与外观变化，缺乏三维几何；模型探测还显示，动作注意力常忽视具身与物体的交互及其转变。Gnomon4D联合生成未来视频、机器人动作和四维几何运动场GeoDelta，并依据相对运动及任务线索选择动作读取的位置和时机。该方法在RoboTwin 2.0、VLABench、RoboDojo及真实机器人评测中表现突出，视觉变化下优势尤为明显。GeoDelta还连接人类动作自由预训练与机器人中期训练，提供跨具身迁移的新途径。
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) predict scene changes to guide robot actions, yet their RGB futures entangle state changes with appearance and lack 3D geometry. Recent WAMs add geometry as a training signal or a control interface, or build native 3D models, but decide what geometry to model rather than how the action should read it. Intuitively, control-relevant cues lie at embodiment--object interactions and their transitions, yet probing existing WAMs reveals that their action attention underweights these interactions in favor of the rest of the embodiment. To focus the action on these interactions, we present Gnomon4D, a WAM that jointly generates future video, robot actions, and GeoDelta, a video-aligned 4D geometric motion field recording the image-plane displacement and depth change of embodiment and object points. With the embodiment and objects in one field, their relative motion, which marks an interaction, can be read off. Guided by this motion and the task, Interaction-Salient Attention (InSAttn) selects where the action reads, and Transition-Anchored Aggregation (TransAgg) selects when, around grasp and release. As GeoDelta encodes surface motion rather than embodiment-specific controls, it serves as a human--robot quasi-action that links action-free pretraining on EgoManip-5000H, which we curate, to robot mid-training on Robot-30H. Gnomon4D leads on RoboTwin~2.0, VLABench, and RoboDojo, and outperforms real-robot baselines, especially under visual shifts. Project page: https://droliven.github.io/Gnomon4D.

papers.title_en: OctreeSplat: Hierarchical Octree-Guided Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Yibin Zhao, Yihan Pan, Wenli Yang, Jun Nan, Jianjun Yi
papers.evidence: 前馈三维高斯泼溅用于重建，并由层级八叉树引导空间细节分配
papers.tldr: 前馈式三维高斯泼溅可免去逐场景优化，但固定图像或空间分辨率难以按局部几何复杂度分配表示，影响新视角合成与重建质量。OctreeSplat借助冻结视觉基础模型提取多视角特征和几何先验，构建层级八叉树并预测致密化分数，以自适应配置高斯基元；同时用随机实体体积渲染强化深度监督，且可选测试时优化相机参数。实验覆盖Replica、TUM、Tanks and Temples与DTU，在彩色视图、深度合成和表面重建上表现有竞争力，并减少高斯数量。该方法以较少新增参数和训练开销实现高效、紧凑的前馈三维表示。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for novel view synthesis (NVS) and 3D reconstruction. Feed-forward methods avoid costly per-scene optimization, but fixed image or spatial resolutions limit their ability to allocate primitives according to local complexity. We present OctreeSplat, a hierarchical octree-guided feed-forward Gaussian splatting. OctreeSplat extracts multi-view features and geometric priors from a frozen visual foundation model (VFM), constructs a hierarchical octree, and predicts densification scores. The resulting representation allocates Gaussian primitives at spatially varying densities according to local complexity. Stochastic solids volume rendering improves depth rendering, strengthens geometric supervision, and supports surface reconstruction. When camera parameters are available, an optional test-time optimization (TTO) module improves agreement between predicted and ground-truth parameters. Training updates only 76 million additional parameters and requires 35 GPU-hours. Experiments on Replica, TUM, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate competitive RGB view synthesis, depth synthesis, and surface reconstruction. OctreeSplat reduces the number of Gaussian primitives while maintaining high reconstruction quality.

papers.title_en: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver
papers.authors: Jeong-gi Kwak, Andrea Tagliasacchi, Sho Kagami, Yuki Ono, Kwang Moo Yi
papers.evidence: 循环Transformer迭代优化多视图几何与相机位姿
papers.tldr: 经典运动恢复结构方法通过迭代优化相机位姿与场景几何，能够扩展地图并利用新观测改进结果；但多数几何基础模型一次性预测，或只能按序更新状态，难以延续求解。Solv3R提出循环式变换器，从当前重建状态继续处理多视图几何，且更新规则不依赖迭代次数。模型经训练可维持准确结果、纠正误差并整合新视图，也可缓存已求解视图作为几何上下文。论文分析其求解动态，并展示一个模型支持离线、增量、重新定位和流式重建，无需任务专用训练或模块。
papers.abstract_en: Classical structure-from-motion reconstruction proceeds iteratively, refining camera poses and scene geometry from a current estimate. This allows maps to easily expand without recomputing already computed views, or geometry estimates to improve as more observations are provided. Most geometric foundation models, however, predict entire geometry in a single forward pass or update a recurrent state as frames arrive sequentially, making this expansion and refinement non-trivial. We introduce Solv3R, a looped transformer that learns to continue solving multi-view geometry from its current state. Importantly, its update operator is independent of the iteration count, allowing previously refined and newly introduced views to be jointly updated regardless of how ``solved'' they are. We train the operator to preserve accurate reconstructions under continued iteration and correct inaccurate states, enabling refinement of fixed image collections and integration of new observations. Representations of solved views can also be cached once and reused as geometric context across iterations, enabling compact and efficient key-value caching. We analyze the solver dynamics and compare it with the state-of-the-art, demonstrating that a single learned solver supports offline reconstruction, incremental reconstruction, relocalization, and streaming without task-specific training or modules. The code and models will be made publicly available at https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/.

papers.title_en: PointPilot: Unified Robotic Manipulation via Object-Centric 3D Point Flow Prediction
papers.authors: Yihan Fang, Yuxin Tian, Ruixiang Wang, Zhanqi Zhang, Xing Hu, Zhen Yang, Huayi Zhou, Yongyi Su, Wei Gao, Kui Jia
papers.evidence: 通过三维点流预测执行统一机器人操作
papers.tldr: 机器人策略要应对本体、相机视角和场景布局变化，但现有方法常依赖额外动作专家，或局限于单臂与半自动执行。PointPilot不预测整个场景，而是围绕任务相关物体及机器人夹爪，统一表示三维空间点流。模型从观测和语言指令端到端学习子任务规划、对象定位与点流预测，并支持闭环自动执行及不同形态演示的共同学习。仿真与真实实验表明，单一策略可零样本迁移至未见机器人形态，无需微调完成操控，显示出跨本体泛化潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Generalization remains a central challenge in robotics, calling for policies that address domain variations from multiple dimensions such as diverse embodiments, camera poses, and/or scene layouts. In order to approach this problem, we introduce PointPilot, a task-focused and 3D aligned manipulation framework built on a 3D space point-flow prediction. Rather than modeling the global scene, PointPilot only represents task-focused objects (robot grippers treated as objects), avoiding the prediction of potentially redundant scene parts unrelated to the manipulation tasks. Moreover, PointPilot aligns 3D spatial representation in one unified coordinate and supports closed-loop and fully automatic action execution across different manipulation modes from object point flow without a separately trained action expert, while existing works typically need an extra action head or are (semi-)automatic and single-arm mode specific. Given sensor observations and language instructions, our model jointly learns subtask planning, task-relevant object grounding, and 3D point flow prediction in an end-to-end way. By processing heterogeneous data in a shared 3D point flow space, PointPilot is able to absorb demonstrations from different embodiments. Extensive simulative and real world experiments validate our method. Notably, we demonstrate zero-shot embodiment generalization with PointPilot. A single trained policy can be deployed on previously unseen embodiments and successfully complete manipulation tasks without any additional fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: GPU-Native Real-Time Textured Mesh Reconstruction with Seam-Aware Multi-View Radiometric Correction
papers.authors: Hiroyuki Sato
papers.evidence: 从RGB-D扫描几何自动重建带纹理三角网格
papers.tldr: 多路RGB-D体积视频要实时输出可渲染的带纹理三角网格，但既有方案常把网格处理或纹理工作交给CPU，或在阶段间传回数据，形成开销。本文将体素融合、网格提取、噪声清理、视角纹理映射、补洞和辐射接缝校正留在GPU，并用定长数组实现高效邻接访问。针对单相机逐面贴图产生的曝光接缝，方法估计相机低频增益场并烘焙进纹理图集。在CMU Panoptic测试中，各分辨率和传感器数量下均快于基线，峰值较加速体素系统及CPU方案快逾十倍，感知重渲染质量接近离线方案。
papers.abstract_en: We present a GPU-native volumetric-video system for real-time reconstruction of graphics-compatible textured triangle meshes from multiple RGB-D sensors. Existing TSDF systems accelerate fusion and mesh extraction, but extending them to per-frame textured meshing adds CPU mesh processing, CPU-side texturing work, or extra CPU-GPU transfers between stages. After input staging, our method keeps the reconstruction and texturing stages (TSDF fusion, Marching Cubes, connected-component noise removal, view-based texture mapping, inpainting, and radiometric seam correction) resident on the GPU; no intermediate mesh or image data returns to the host between these stages. A fixed-size-array representation of mesh topology gives constant-time neighbor access on the GPU and makes the downstream mesh-level operations data-parallel. Because we texture each face from a single camera, exposure seams that vary smoothly across each image remain; we estimate a per-camera low-frequency gain field and bake it into the atlas on the GPU. On the CMU Panoptic dataset, our method is faster than the baselines at every tested voxel resolution and number of sensors, achieves peak speedups of more than an order of magnitude over CUDA-accelerated nvblox and CPU-based Open3D, and approaches an offline textured-meshing baseline in perceptual re-rendering quality.

papers.title_en: AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds
papers.authors: Weirong Chen, Ismail El-Yamany, Ganlin Zhang, Chuanxia Zheng, Andrea Vedaldi, Daniel Cremers
papers.evidence: 从部分点云补全场景网格并保留已观测几何
papers.tldr: 基于图像的三维重建通常只能恢复可见表面，留下大面积孔洞，且难以推断未观测几何；在稀疏视角和不同场景尺度下，完整重建尤其困难。AnchorComplete基于TRELLIS.2，将全局场景令牌与局部空间证据结合，以部分点云约束生成，并按度量尺度在固定大小窗口中由粗到细细化几何、保持整体结构一致。Replica与SCRREAM实验显示，该方法持续优于强基线，稀疏视角下优势尤为明显。它为从不完整点云恢复完整场景网格提供了兼顾观测保真与尺度适应的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Most image-based 3D reconstructors primarily recover visible surfaces, producing partial point clouds with large holes and leaving unobserved geometry unresolved. To address this limitation, we introduce AnchorComplete, a framework that reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds while preserving observed geometry and supporting scenes of varying scales. Building on TRELLIS.2, our method combines partial-point conditioning, which integrates global scene tokens with local spatial evidence to anchor generation to the input, and metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, which progressively refines scene geometry within fixed-size windows while maintaining global structural consistency. Experiments on Replica and SCRREAM demonstrate that AnchorComplete consistently outperforms strong baselines in complete-scene reconstruction, particularly under sparse-view settings.

papers.title_en: CoLa3D: Composable Latent 3D Decomposition
papers.authors: Xudong Cai, Yongcai Wang, Deying Li, Chuanxia Zheng
papers.evidence: 从整体场景潜变量分解出布局一致的对象网格
papers.tldr: 三维场景分解需从整体输入中恢复对象网格，同时保持各物体空间布局与场景几何一致。传统方案逐对象在规范空间生成，再估计位姿和尺度拼接，容易造成布局不稳。CoLa3D从单张图像或现有场景网格提取共享场景潜变量，以查询式变换器直接分解出可重新组装的对象网格。实验显示，该方法在合成和真实数据上提升场景一致性与对象质量，速度约快两倍，训练数据不足SAM 3D的百分之一，并保留准确可见几何。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce CoLa3D, a simple and effective model for composable 3D scene decomposition that, given a single whole-scene latent from either a single image or an existing scene mesh as input, directly outputs a set of object meshes with consistent spatial layout that can be assembled back into a coherent scene. CoLa3D introduces a novel paradigm for 3D scene decomposition within a shared whole-scene latent, unlike alternatives that perform per-object generation in canonical spaces and then glue the objects back together with fragile pose and scale estimation. The network is a lightweight, flexible, and scalable query-based transformer that accepts various types of queries, including 2D masks, 3D points, and learnable queries, and learns to decompose the scene into objects in a compact latent space. On both synthetic and real-world datasets, CoLa3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on composable 3D scene decomposition, substantially improving global scene-level consistency and object-level quality while running 2 times faster and using less than 1% of SAM 3D's training data. Visible depth on par with MoGe2 further confirms that latent decomposition preserves accurate visible scene geometry while producing physically complete, decomposable object meshes.

papers.title_en: ActOR: Ambient AI-Based Agentic Orchestration for Humanoid Autonomy in Operating Rooms
papers.authors: Han Zhang, Sicheng Lu, Aleks Santari, Jeffrey K. Jopling, Masaru Ishii, Mathias Unberath
papers.evidence: 融合环境与机载感知，支持人形机器人在真实场景中自主行动
papers.tldr: 手术室虽逐渐具备环境感知设施，但人形机器人仅凭机载视野难以快速定位物体并规划任务，遇到场景变化或执行偏差时更易失败。ActOR将墙载环境相机与机器人头部相机融合为共享物体级数字孪生，由大语言模型调用预设移动和操作技能规划，并根据执行结果及场景更新重试或重规划。在两个模拟手术室中，环境感知将探索调用由每次试验1.05次降至0.12次，闭环反馈提升名义及扰动条件下的任务成功率；实体模拟手术室中完成20次单物体处置的14次。结果展示了环境AI与执行反馈协同提升人形机器人手术室自主性的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Operating rooms (ORs) increasingly contain ambient sensing infrastructure to enable AI-based optimization of workflows and utilization. We pursue an alternative path: using ambient AI to guide robot action and optimize utilization. Deploying humanoids in the OR without ambient AI is severely limited by cumbersome de novo orientation and planning due to partial onboard observations. We posit that this can be achieved by coupling an ambient AI-based agentic orchestrator with the humanoid robotic actor, providing shared perception and execution feedback for humanoid autonomy in the OR. ActOR fuses a wall-mounted ambient camera and the robot's head-mounted camera into a shared object-level digital twin (DT). A large language model agent plans over the DT using pre-programmed locomotion and manipulation skills without task-specific training. During execution, DT updates and execution outcomes inform retries, alternative approaches, or replanning. We evaluated ActOR in simulated and physical environments. Across three tasks in two simulated ORs reconstructed from real rooms, ambient perception reduced exploration from 1.05 to 0.12 Explore calls per trial when targets were initially outside the robot's view. Closed-loop feedback increased success from 46.7% to 83.3% under nominal execution and from 8.3% to 51.7% under injected navigation, object-relocation, and grasp perturbations. In a physical mock OR with a humanoid, ActOR completed 14 of 20 single-object disposal trials and demonstrated replanning after scene changes. Ambient AI-based observations provide scene state that improves robot action planning, increasing success and reducing exploration compared with robot-only observations. Feeding skill outcomes and DT updates back to the planner improves multi-step task success. Our results show the feasibility of humanoid task autonomy for multi-step disposal tasks in a mock OR.

papers.title_en: GVT3D: Gesture-Vision-Text Token Enrichment for 3D Embodied Reference Understanding
papers.authors: Vimarsh Shah, Dulanga Weerakoon, Ajinkya Deshpande, Saksham Agarwal, Nilesh Bhatia, Neel Kiran Naik, Parth Shah, Sravan Danda, Sanjay E. Sarma, Archan Misra, Vigneshwaran Subbaraju, Sougata Sen
papers.evidence: 融合语言、手势与点云视觉以定位目标物体
papers.tldr: 自然人机交互需要机器人结合语言、手势与三维场景，定位人所指的目标物体；三维具身指代理解正面临模态表征对齐不足、点云处理成本随规模增长的问题。GVT3D以具身融合模块在共享嵌入空间联合建模语言、指向手势和视觉，并根据估计的指向区域选择性处理点云。实验显示，模型准确率较既有方法提高约百分之八，聚焦处理速度提升二点九五倍且准确率相近。该方法兼顾跨模态理解与计算效率，为机器人执行物体检索、抓取放置等任务提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Natural human-robot interaction requires robots to interpret language and gestures within a 3D environment to support tasks such as pick-and-place and object retrieval. 3D Embodied Reference Understanding (3D-ERU) supports this by identifying the 3D location of a target object from a scene (point-cloud) containing a human pointing gesture and an accompanying language description. However, current 3D-ERU models lack alignment of cross-modal representations and incur high processing costs that increase with the point-cloud's size. To address this, we propose GVT3D, which employs an Embodied Fusion module that jointly models language, gesture, and vision inputs within a shared embedding space, promoting cross-modal alignment. We additionally introduce a foveation approach that selectively processes the point cloud within a coarse region around the estimated pointing direction to reduce computations. GVT3D achieves ~8% higher accuracy and foveation enables 2.95x faster execution while maintaining comparable accuracy, relative to prior 3D-ERU models.

papers.title_en: Hybrid Particle-Voxel Dynamics for Multimodal 3D World Simulation
papers.authors: Jimmy Wang, Yifan Chou, Kaifeng Zhang, Yixuan Wang, Binghao Huang, Tao Yu, Saleh Nabi, Yunzhu Li
papers.evidence: 预测机器人动作导致的三维环境变化与多模态观测
papers.tldr: 机器人策略学习、评估与规划需要预测动作如何改变环境，但仅在二维图像或视频中建模，难以维持跨视角和长时程的空间一致性，也难以融合触觉。论文提出三维世界模拟器，以混合粒子—体素自编码器压缩点云，再由动作条件潜在动力学预测三维状态演化，并统一生成外观、几何与触觉观测。模型实现每秒50帧的交互式长时程多模态预测，可从任意视角渲染，并支持腕部和新视角数据生成。实验还展示其在多样物体数据上的扩展能力，以及对未见物体和机器人配置进行模型规划的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Predicting how the world evolves in response to robot actions is central to policy learning, evaluation, and planning. However, many action-conditioned world models predict future observations in 2D image or video space without explicitly modeling the underlying 3D scene, making spatial consistency across viewpoints and over long-horizon interactions challenging. We introduce 3D World Simulator, an action-conditioned multimodal world modeling framework that jointly predicts appearance, geometry, and tactile observations from a unified 3D representation. Our approach combines a hybrid particle-voxel autoencoder that compresses point clouds into compact 3D voxel latents with an action-conditioned latent dynamics model that predicts their evolution. The shared 3D representation supports geometrically consistent rendering from arbitrary viewpoints and flexible integration of spatially aligned tactile signals. Our experiments demonstrate interactive, long-horizon, multimodal prediction at 50 Hz. We then show how our model enables scalable data generation for policy training and evaluation using tactile and multi-view visual observations, including wrist-mounted and novel camera views. Furthermore, we scale our method to large datasets containing diverse objects and demonstrate model-based planning with unseen objects and robot configurations. Together, these results highlight the potential of hybrid particle-voxel dynamics as a foundation for multimodal 3D world simulation.

papers.title_en: HiLo-WAM: Decoupling Long-Horizon Task Evolution and Local Dynamics in World Action Models
papers.authors: Xingyu Wang, Yanjiang Guo, Zhijing Ding, Jiaxin Fang, Zeyu Lai, Jiayu Dong, Weikang Wan, Jianyu Chen, Yuxiang Gao, Mengdi Xu
papers.evidence: 世界动作模型预测场景变化并联合建模机器人动作
papers.tldr: 现有世界动作模型多聚焦密集短时视觉预测，虽能刻画局部交互，却缺乏长程任务演化信息；直接拉长预测会增加不确定性与计算，并混淆任务进程和局部动力学。HiLo-WAM采用双DiT架构，分别以稀疏视觉流建模长时任务演化、以密集视觉流刻画局部动力学，并通过跨流注意力协同生成动作。在RoboTwin 2.0成功率达93.70%，RoboDojo得分17.43，渐进推理提速2.93倍且提升性能。研究表明，分离并协同不同时间尺度，有助于兼顾长程规划、精细操作与推理效率。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual dynamics and robot actions. However, most existing WAMs model dense short-horizon visual dynamics, capturing local interactions but providing limited long-range task context. Extending prediction horizons increases uncertainty and computation while entangling task-level evolution with fine-grained local dynamics, obscuring their dependencies and distinct roles in action generation. We propose HiLo-WAM, which decouples long-horizon task evolution from local visual dynamics while jointly modeling their interaction with robot actions. A sparse long-horizon visual stream captures historical task context and future evolution, while a dense local dynamics visual stream models short-horizon robot-object interactions. The two streams operate at different temporal scales within a unified dual-DiT architecture and guide actions through structured cross-stream attention. Progressive inference further reduces unnecessary computation through stream-wise partial denoising, joint denoising, and dynamic skipping. Experiments demonstrate strong long-horizon manipulation performance: HiLo-WAM achieves a 93.70% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 and a 17.43 progress score on RoboDojo long-horizon tasks, with robust in-domain and OOD performance on the Fourier GR-3 robot. Ablations confirm the complementary contributions of long-horizon task evolution and local interaction dynamics, while temporal-scale analyses highlight the importance of balancing temporal coverage and resolution. Progressive inference further achieves a 2.93x speedup while improving performance.

papers.title_en: DexHOT: Learning Hand-Object Configuration Transfer for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Zhewei Gui, Anthony Bolton, Jiyao Zhang, Zeyuan Chen, Qiyang Yan, Tianyu Wang, Hao Dong
papers.evidence: 学习手部与物体构型之间的灵巧操作迁移
papers.tldr: 灵巧操作不仅要移动物体，还需安排手部姿态与接触，才能维持有效抓持并支持后续动作；仅以物体位姿或轨迹设定目标，难以直接控制这种手物关系。DexHOT将手部关节姿态和物体相对腕部的位姿组成联合构型，从合成可行构型对学习可复用的关系条件转移策略，并通过闭环跟踪构型子目标组合长时序行为。该方法在120个物体上对已见与未见物体分别取得80.5%和69.4%的转移成功率，真实手部转移成功率为61.5%，六项任务成功率为90%。结果表明，显式手物构型目标能为灵巧操作提供更具表达力且可组合的控制接口。
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation involves not only moving objects, but also arranging the hand around them to maintain useful contacts and enable subsequent actions. Yet many learning-based systems specify goals primarily through object poses or trajectories, leaving hand-object configurations to emerge implicitly. We introduce DexHOT, which formulates dexterous manipulation as hand-object configuration transfer: moving between feasible configurations that jointly specify hand articulation and object pose relative to the wrist. DexHOT learns a reusable relation-conditioned transfer primitive from synthetic feasible configuration pairs, without human reference motions, and composes long-horizon behaviors through closed-loop tracking of configuration subgoals. On DexHOTBench with 120 objects, a single policy achieves 80.5% transfer success on seen objects and 69.4% on unseen objects; on a real dexterous hand, it achieves 61.5% success over 200 real-robot transfers and 90% task success across six demonstration-guided tasks. These results show that explicit hand-object goals provide an expressive and composable interface for dexterous manipulation. More details and videos are available at https://dex-hot.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Learning Object-Centric Motion Priors from Human for Robotic Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Zhengdong Hong, Guofeng Zhang
papers.evidence: 从人类物体交互学习先验以支持机器人灵巧操作
papers.tldr: 多指灵巧手需要在高维控制和复杂动力学下操纵多种物体，而直接模仿人类示范或为每项任务设计奖励，难以兼顾泛化与适应性。该方法从人类—物体交互数据中学习并整体预测未来手部和物体状态，将物体未来状态用作强化学习的通用奖励，减少任务专用奖励设计。仿真和真实环境的三类操作任务结果表明，该方法成功率更高，对新物体泛化更好。技能还可部署到不同构型的机器人手，体现了跨任务、跨物体和跨手型迁移潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Manipulating diverse objects with multi-fingered dexterous hands is challenging due to the high dimensionality and complex dynamics. Human-Object Interaction (HOI) datasets provide rich knowledge about task information and embodied interactions. Instead of solely imitating the human demonstrations, our method learns to holistically predict future hand-object states by leveraging these datasets. The predicted future states of the object can serve as a general-purpose reward term for reinforcement learning, reducing reliance on task-specific reward engineering and enhancing generalization across tasks. We conduct extensive experiments on three manipulation tasks in simulation and the real world. Our approach outperforms existing SOTA methods in both success rate and generalizability on novel objects. Furthermore, we validate the cross-embodiment compatibility of our methods by successfully deploying the skills on different robot hands.

papers.title_en: Quo Vadis, Driving Scene Reconstruction? Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification
papers.authors: Dung Do Tien, Kien Nguyen Do Trung, Kiet Dang Vu, Trung Thai Tran, Duc Dung Nguyen
papers.evidence: 前馈高斯场景重建通过预测新基元补全未观测的三维几何
papers.tldr: 现有前馈式驾驶场景三维高斯重建依赖单次环视观测，输入中被遮挡的区域缺少约束，换到新视角时容易显露不完整几何。OccSplat提出遮挡感知高斯致密化，先定位缺乏高斯支撑的遮挡区域，再为其生成并融合新的高斯基元。nuScenes实验显示，该方法优于对比方法，且在遮挡区域收益尤为明显。它直接补全三维表示而非仅修补渲染像素，并保持无需逐场景优化的前馈推理。
papers.abstract_en: While recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting methods enable efficient driving-scene reconstruction from surround-view images, their reliance on a single observation fundamentally hinders novel-view synthesis. Regions occluded in the input can become visible from novel viewpoints, leaving the reconstructed Gaussians under-constrained and incomplete. Moving beyond image-space inpainting for rendered views, we introduce OccSplat, a feed-forward framework whose core contribution is Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification, explicitly targeting missing scene geometry rather than missing pixels. By predicting new Gaussian primitives for unsupported regions, OccSplat completes the scene directly in the 3D representation. Specifically, OccSplat first identifies occluded regions that lack Gaussian support through Gaussian Occlusion Mapping. Gaussian Occlusion Completion then generates new primitives for these regions. The predicted primitives are integrated into the original representation to improve novel-view synthesis while retaining feed-forward inference without per-scene optimization. Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that OccSplat improves on the compared methods and yields particularly large gains in occluded regions, leading to more accurate and visually coherent driving-scene reconstruction.

papers.title_en: $A^3$-VLA: Automatic Perception-Guided Attention Alignment for Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Shengzhe Zhang, Qi Zhang, Dazhong Shen, Chao Wang, Shaopeng Zhai, Hui Xiong
papers.evidence: 直接研究机器人感知与物体操作
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型利用视觉与语言执行操作，但动作预测缺少细粒度、任务相关的感知监督，容易依赖无关线索并忽略目标物体和关键交互区域。A³-VLA从操作造成的视觉变化中自动生成并细化候选区域，再通过注意力分配和对比学习引导视觉关注及语言对齐。在仿真与真实任务中，该方法提升多种模型骨干，跨基准平均成功率增加6.5%至25.2%。这为模型提供了可从操作过程获得的显式感知引导，有助于改善操作表现与泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) enable robots to perform manipulation tasks by leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to process visual observations and language instructions. However, the action prediction objective itself lacks fine-grained task-specific perceptual supervision, making it prone to relying on task-irrelevant visual shortcuts, leading attention away from target objects and key interaction areas, thereby limiting its operational performance and generalization ability. To address this, we propose Automatic Perception-Guided Attention Alignment for Robot Manipulation ($A^3$-VLA), a framework that derives task-specific visual guidance from the manipulation process itself. Specifically, $A^3$-VLA first generates heuristic candidate regions for target objects and the robot from interaction-induced visual changes, and refines them with a visual segmentation model offline. These regions serve as explicit perceptual guidance through two complementary objectives: an attention allocation loss that encourages sufficient focus on task-critical regions when language or robot state tokens query the visual input, and a contrastive learning loss that aligns the representations of candidate target regions with language instructions while separating them from task-irrelevant regions. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that $A^3$-VLA consistently improves multiple VLA backbones, with an average success rate gain of 6.5% - 25.2% across benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Open-HumanWAM: An Open Recipe for Scaling Human and Robot Experience for Embodied Foundation Models
papers.authors: Juncheng Ma, Jiaxin Li, Jiankai Tu, Bo Liang, Guodong Lv, Yufan Deng, Junzhe Tang, Liangzhu Yang, Chen Bian, Shukai Gong, Yintianrun Zhang, Zicong Cao, Baohao Zhu, Jianxin Bi, Tengfei Yan, Yinyuan Zhang, Kewei Zhang, Xinglong Chen, Kaiqi Chen, Duomin Wang, Xiaotian Tang, Liang Tan, Li Li, Yuan Xu, Haosen Yang, Yuqi Wang, Jingfei Xia, Songyan Huang, Zhiyang Dou, Zhen Dong, Enze Xie, Tat-Seng Chua, Daquan Zhou
papers.evidence: 利用第一人称人类操作经验训练具身机器人基础模型
papers.tldr: 机器人操作学习需要规模化经验，但原始人类视频难以直接转化为泛化策略；研究据此提出开放的数据整理与训练配方，并发布含手部动作和语言标注的5万小时第一视角视频集。作者通过闭环仿真发现，纯人类预训练数据时长与下游成功率呈对数线性关系，再以人机混合预训练提升能力。后训练后，模型在RoboTwin清洁到随机任务达到84.60%成功率，并能在实体机器人上适应未见视觉目标。该工作开放数据、流程、模型及评测工具，为具身基础模型的规模化研究提供可复现基准。
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric human video offers a scalable source of manipulation priors for robot learning, yet translating raw data scale into generalizable robot policies demands rigorous data curation and training recipes. We introduce Open-HumanWAM, the first fully open recipe for scaling egocentric pretraining to 50,000 hours, anchored by Open-HumanWAM-50K---a curated egocentric video corpus densely annotated with hand motion and natural language. Leveraging this corpus, we systematically investigate pure human pretraining via closed-loop simulation evaluations and uncover an empirical log-linear scaling law linking pretraining data hours to downstream robot success rates. Grounded in these findings, we develop HumanWAM-Vanilla, a world--action model pretrained exclusively on 50k hours of egocentric human video. Upon robot post-training, HumanWAM-Vanilla reaches 92.08% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean and 68.88% on Clean2Random, alongside a 14.17% mean success rate and a 19.00 mean progress score on RoboDojo. To push the capability frontier further, we explore joint human--robot pretraining with HumanWAM-Goal, a visual-goal-conditioned world--action model. Hybrid data scaling unlocks broad zero-shot generalization across both simulation and physical benchmarks, propelling post-trained RoboTwin 2.0 performance to new state-of-the-art levels: 92.70% on Clean2Clean and a substantial leap to 84.60% on Clean2Random. On physical robots, HumanWAM-Goal further exhibits emergent embodied in-context learning, dynamically adapting its manipulation behavior to unseen visual goals without parameter updates. To support reproducible scaling research in embodied AI, we open-source the Open-HumanWAM-50K corpus, data curation and pretraining pipelines, alongside the pretrained and post-trained HumanWAM checkpoints, inference code, and simulation evaluation suites.

papers.title_en: MessyNav: Zero-Shot Navigation via Manipulation in Messy Environments
papers.authors: Kenneth Llontop, Cherie Ho, Dylan Zhou, Anuva Banwasi, Priya Sundaresan, Carlota Parés-Morlans, Jeannette Bohg
papers.evidence: 通过操作障碍物完成真实环境导航
papers.tldr: 真实室内外环境常被椅子、玩具等日常物品阻塞，机器人若只绕行难以完成任务；逐场景指定避让或清障规则，也难适应新物体及其具体状态。MessyNav提出开放世界交互导航框架，先借助视觉语言模型进行显式可供性判断，再规划推开、拾取或避让等动作。真实机器人实验中，其成功率较最强基线高27个百分点，大规模离线评估也取得显著提升。该方法无需任务专项训练，为杂乱环境中的零样本移动操作提供了可泛化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world environments are messy, with paths often blocked by everyday objects like chairs and toys, requiring robots to perform interactive navigation by manipulating obstacles to clear a path. Existing methods rely on extensive simulation-based learning or per-scene instructions specifying which objects to avoid or manipulate. They struggle to generalize across novel objects, diverse environments, and varied contexts such as a cart of fragile glassware that should be avoided while an empty one can be pushed. We formalize this problem as open-world interactive navigation and present MessyNav, a zero-shot framework based on vision-language models (VLMs). At its core, MessyNav performs explicit VLM-based affordance reasoning before task planning to decide whether to swipe, pick up, or avoid an object and produce a high-level plan. Evaluated on a mobile manipulator across real-world indoor and outdoor environments, MessyNav improves success rate by 27 percentage points (pp) over the strongest baseline in real-robot trials and achieves statistically significant gains in a larger-scale offline evaluation, without task-specific training.

papers.title_en: Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model
papers.authors: Chengcheng Wang, Wei He, Wenhao Li, Hongguang Li, Kai Han, Jianyuan Guo, Chang Xu
papers.evidence: 统一模型中融合认知与物体操控动作生成
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作策略常将认知与操控分离：离散动作词元的误差难以对应物理位移，独立动作专家也可能阻碍视觉语言主干学习。Concertina提出具身视觉语言模型，让连续轨迹表示、分块生成及物理坐标监督进入共享扩散模型的计算与参数路径。每个控制时刻对应一个连续潜在动作词元，模型以多模态预训练所用的扰动—重建机制生成有序动作块。模型在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus及CALVIN上取得强表现，说明共享主干可统一认知与操控。
papers.abstract_en: Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. Each control timestep is encoded as one continuous latent action token in the backbone hidden space, and the shared Transformer reconstructs temporally ordered action blocks via the same corrupt-and-reconstruct operator used for multimodal pretraining. Active action projections account for only 0.21% of parameters in the 4.46B model with zero separate action-generator layers, compared with 16.5%-35.1% dedicated action-expert capacity in representative continuous VLAs. Using our proposed Action Interface Audit, we confirm that cross-time trajectory coupling emerges in the middle and late layers of the shared backbone rather than at the action interfaces. On standard benchmarks, Concertina achieves 98.15% average success on regular LIBERO, 85.9% on the 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus benchmark, and 4.142 average completed chain length on CALVIN ABC-D.   Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina

papers.title_en: MetricTrail: Revisiting the Power of Metric Depth and Local Optimization for Long-Sequence Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jingnan Gao, Jiahui Huang, Sven Elflein, Jianhao Zheng, Bingxin Ke, Xiaokang Yang, Yichao Yan, Laura Leal-Taixé, Qunjie Zhou, Jiawei Ren, Shengyu Huang
papers.evidence: 度量深度约束与学习特征适配改进长序列流式三维重建
papers.tldr: 长单目视频重建需要在精确估计相机轨迹、恢复稠密几何与控制计算成本之间取得平衡，现有稀疏局部方法仍有精度提升空间。MetricTrail以单图度量深度初始化稀疏局部优化，并将深度作为软约束；同时用冻结的DINOv3特征适配匹配器，无需扩大优化窗口或进行长序列训练。在KITTI、Oxford Spires和VBR的RGB评测中，其平均轨迹误差优于对比方法，提供内参时KITTI-02达到12.70帧每秒。该模块化设计兼顾高效在线处理、稠密重建能力及深度模型独立升级。
papers.abstract_en: We present MetricTrail, a streaming system for accurate camera motion estimation and dense reconstruction from long monocular videos. To keep inference efficient over long sequences, we revisit DPVO's sparse local estimator. We find that single-image metric depth substantially improves its trajectory accuracy, without retraining the correspondence network or enlarging the optimization window. Metric predictions initialize patch depths and remain as soft constraints during optimization. We further improve correspondence estimation through learned adapters that augment matching features and recurrent context with frozen DINOv3 representations. The correspondence estimator and adapters are trained on diverse short clips without additional long-sequence training. This modular design also allows the depth provider to be independently upgraded and supports supplied camera intrinsics and calibrated stereo observations without retraining. Under the reported RGB-only protocols, MetricTrail achieves the lowest average trajectory error among evaluated methods on KITTI, Oxford Spires, and VBR. Pairing the estimated poses with single-image depth predictions also produces strong dense reconstruction on indoor and outdoor benchmarks and coherent reconstructions of in-the-wild videos. With supplied intrinsics, the system processes KITTI-02 at 12.70 FPS with 3.21 GB peak GPU memory.

papers.title_en: SM4RT: Cascaded Feed-forward Model for 4D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Pang-Chi Lo, Jhao-Syun Lai, Tsung-Wei Ke
papers.evidence: 级联前馈模型先重建三维几何，再估计动态场景运动
papers.tldr: 动态场景的RGB视频重建需要同时恢复三维几何与时序运动，但现有前馈方法常将两者分开处理；在统一坐标系中估计运动，也容易混淆物体运动与相机运动。SM4RT采用级联多任务框架，先预测几何，再以结构引导运动估计，并在对应相机坐标系表示像素的三维运动。针对真实场景运动标注稀疏，模型利用另一时间步的已标注点位置，对未标注点运动施加弱监督约束。实验显示，该方法在Kubric、Waymo和Point Odyssey的多数运动指标上领先，并在五个动态数据集的几何重建上具竞争力，说明级联联合推理能改善运动估计并避免任务间性能权衡。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SM4RT, a multi-task cascade feed-forward model for dynamic scene reconstruction from RGB videos. While existing feed-forward approaches typically address geometry reconstruction and motion estimation separately--and often predict motions in a single coordinate frame that must account for camera movement--SM4RT solves these tasks sequentially by first reconstructing 3D geometry and then bootstrapping motion estimation from the predicted structure. By expressing each pixel's 3D motion in its corresponding camera frame, SM4RT reduces ambiguity arising from camera motion. To address the sparsity of real-world motion labels, SM4RT further incorporates a weakly supervised loss that regularizes unlabeled point motions using labeled point positions at the other time step. We evaluate motion estimation on three dynamic-scene datasets--Kubric, Waymo, and Point Odyssey--and SM4RT achieves the best performance on most metrics compared with prior baselines. We additionally benchmark geometry reconstruction on five dynamic scene datasets and show that SM4RT achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods. Overall, our unified framework demonstrates that combining geometry reconstruction and motion estimation in a cascade not only avoids performance trade-offs but also enhances motion estimation through improved geometric reasoning.

papers.title_en: FlowMoDE: Coarse-to-fine Flow Matching for Detail-aware Sim-to-Real Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Liangjing Shao, Wanhao Liu, Jinsong Lin, Zhiwei Fang, Hongliang Ren
papers.evidence: 提出高效的单目深度估计方法
papers.tldr: 单目深度估计服务于机器人三维感知，但生成式方法往往采样效率低，单步方法又难兼顾结构细节与精度。FlowMoDE采用粗到细的流匹配：以预训练语义编码器提取并扩散特征，先解码粗深度，再用扩展解码层恢复精细结构。模型仅在单一合成室内数据集上训练，却在五个真实室内外数据集上取得平均相对误差降低14.1%的结果，点云重建倒角距离也降低9.9%。实验还展示了其在真实机器人场景中的泛化能力，体现了高效推理、细节还原与跨场景迁移的结合。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation is a fundamental capability for 3D spatial perception in robotic and intelligent systems. While data-driven discriminative methods have achieved compelling performance for monocular depth estimation, generative approaches can reconstruct fine structural details with stronger generalization. However, most existing generative diffusion models suffer from low inference efficiency caused by multi-step sampling, whereas single-step diffusion models struggle to recover high-fidelity depth maps. To mitigate these drawbacks, this paper presents FlowMoDE, a coarse-to-fine flow-matching-based framework for efficient, structure-aware monocular depth estimation supporting sim-to-real and cross-scene generalization. The core architecture first conducts coarse-level decoding conditioned on diffused features extracted from a pre-trained semantic encoder, and subsequently restores fine-grained structural patterns via expanded decoding layers. Trained exclusively on a single synthetic indoor dataset, our proposed method outperforms prior methods across five real-world indoor and outdoor datasets, yielding an average 14.1% reduction in relative error against state-of-the-art works as well as 9.9\% reduction in chamfer distance for point cloud reconstruction. We further validate the generalization capability of FlowMoDE on realistic robotic scenes, with qualitative comparisons against state-of-the-art methods. The project page is https://flowmode-shao.netlify.app/

papers.title_en: Cross-Embodiment Motion Planning by Coupling Body-Agnostic World Model with Differentiable Ego-Dynamics
papers.authors: Zhidong Wang, Zirui Li, Haoran Xu, Yujie Yan, Zitong Shan, Jingsong Liang, Han Yu, Chen Lv
papers.evidence: 结合世界模型和机器人自身动力学进行运动规划
papers.tldr: 拥挤环境中的运动规划受机器人形态、动力学及相机安装影响，单一归一化指令策略难以跨本体复用，逐机器人训练成本高。论文提出Hourglass，将跨本体共享的身体无关世界模型与各机器人可微自运动学在相机自运动接口耦合，并以参数条件策略进行想象训练。七种模拟机器人上成功率较同一世界模型基线高3.8至10.6个百分点，接近专用策略与MPPI教师；真实滑移转向机器人经三分钟辨识后可零样本迁移。结果表明，按接口分解可兼顾跨本体数据共享与个体动力学适配，并无需在线建图。
papers.abstract_en: Motion planning in clutter is embodiment-specific: the feasible free space and reachable commands depend on each robot's geometry and dynamics. Existing cross-embodiment policies output normalized commands that disregard these differences, or compensate through per-robot training and distillation. World models can in principle pool cross-embodiment data, yet command-conditioned models bind their latent dynamics to a single action space, while pose-conditioned models omit the mapping from commands to body-specific motion. On flat ground, however, embodiment affects the planner's observations only through the camera ego-motion. This letter proposes Hourglass, an hourglass-shaped architecture that factorizes cross-embodiment motion planning at this interface: a body-agnostic world model and each robot's differentiable ego-dynamics, which map commands to that ego-motion, are coupled only through it. The world model is trained on data pooled across embodiments and camera mounts; each robot's ego-dynamics is a reduced-order template with identified physical parameters. A generalist parameter-conditioned policy is learned once at this junction: each imagined step rolls out the template and then the world model, and imagination training through each robot's template makes the policy body-aware. On seven simulated robots of five locomotion types, the generalist policy outperforms imitation-learning and diffusion-policy baselines on the same world model by 3.8--10.6 percentage points in success rate and matches per-robot specialists without dedicated training, while approaching its parameter-conditioned MPPI teacher within 1.4--2.8 points without an online map. After three minutes of teleoperated driving for identification, the synthetic-data-trained model transfers zero-shot to a real skid-steer robot unseen in training, navigating unseen indoor scenes.

papers.title_en: PGGT-Loc: Primitive-Grounded Geometry Transformer for Feed-Forward Camera Localization
papers.authors: Hanqiao Ye, Yuzhou Liu, Mengqi Rong, Jian Liu, Yangdong Liu, Shuhan Shen
papers.evidence: 几何变换器将视觉观测与地图基元匹配以估计相机位姿
papers.tldr: 相机定位常依赖复杂且维护成本高的地图，而紧凑的结构化地图虽包含几何与语义线索，直接用于定位仍受地图原语和图像观测之间模态差异的阻碍。PGGT-Loc提出以平面地图原语为依据的定位思路，使用几何变换器将单张查询图像与一组地图原语关联，并预测多个定位目标，完成前馈式六自由度相机定位。论文报告该方法能够泛化到未见环境，并在稠密表面地图和极简布局模型上均取得新的最优定位表现。该工作探索了无需传统多阶段流程、直接利用结构化地图进行可扩展定位的路径。
papers.abstract_en: Camera localization methods are mostly multi-stage pipelines relying on dedicated and complex maps that are costly to construct, store, and maintain over time. Alternatively, well-structured maps that organize scenes with compact yet expressive primitives are often readily available, providing rich structural and semantic cues that humans can interpret. However, their potential for direct camera localization remains largely unexplored due to the significant modality gap between map primitives and visual observations. This motivates a new concept for localization, which estimates camera poses by grounding query observations to map primitives. In this paper, we instantiate the concept in the context of planar primitives with PGGT, the Primitive-Grounded Geometry Transformer network. Given a single query image and a set of planar map primitives, the network is trained to predict multiple localization targets for feed-forward 6-DoF camera localization that generalizes to unseen environments. With this straightforward and scalable architecture, our method pushes the state-of-the-art localization performance on both dense surface maps and minimal layout models. The code and models are available at https://github.com/3dv-casia/PGGT-Loc

papers.title_en: META-Robot: Self-Cognition and Capability Scaling in Agentic Robots
papers.authors: Xuanzhi Feng, Zeyu Liu, Weiheng Gao, Xinchen Li, Jiankun Tang, Fangqi Zhu, Quanxin Shou, Hao Chen, Zhengyang Yan, Hualei Zhang, Junhao Li, Zhiyao Wu, Jie Zhang, Song Guo
papers.evidence: 机器人通过动作级评估与本体反馈发展并评估自身能力
papers.tldr: 基于大语言模型的机器人智能体能够生成控制程序，但面对新任务时常依赖复杂脚手架，单纯增加技能也难以判断能力边界。META-Robot以动作级谓词显式评估执行结果，并结合本体感知反馈，使智能体识别短板、扩展评估标准并有序发展相关技能。仿真与真实机器人实验显示，该框架提升任务表现和新任务泛化，且能持续扩充技能与评估标准、利用非视觉本体信号。研究由此联结能力评估与技能增长，为机器人自主认知和能力扩展提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based robotic agent systems can generate programs for robot control, yet their generalization to new tasks often depends on elaborate scaffolding. Expanding their skill repertoires alone offers limited guidance on how to assess new capabilities or identify what remains beyond their reach. We introduce META-Robot, a framework that couples self cognition with capability scaling by expanding the criteria through which an agent evaluates and develops its skills. At its core, action-level predicates make execution outcomes explicit and available for LLM reasoning. The agent uses these assessments to identify its own limitations, extend relevant evaluation criteria, and guide the structured expansion of its skills. Proprioceptive feedback further grounds this process in the robot's physical state, enriching the evidence available for self-cognition. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate stronger overall task performance, generalization to new tasks, continued expansion of skills and evaluation criteria, and effective use of non-visual proprioceptive signals.

papers.title_en: Nexus-VLA: Bridging Human and Robot Experiences via a Shared Hierarchical Semantic Latent Space
papers.authors: Biaoliang Guan, Tingyu Yuan, Wen Ye, Ziming Ji, Xu Yang, Yan Huang, Jihua Zhu, Chaoyang Zhao
papers.evidence: 将人类操作视频经验迁移到机器人策略学习
papers.tldr: 大规模第一人称人类视频蕴含丰富操作经验，可用于机器人策略学习，但视觉外观、运动结构和动作空间差异使迁移困难。Nexus-VLA 通过端到端人机联合训练，逐层对齐任务意图与细粒度交互语义，并将共享知识编码为直接用于连续动作生成的潜在表示。在 RoboCasa-GR1 上取得 80.5% 的任务成功率，且在分布外场景和真实机器人实验中表现出优势。该方法使人类操作知识更直接地参与机器人学习，提升数据利用效率与跨场景泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale egocentric human videos provide rich and scalable manipulation experience for robot policy learning, yet substantial embodiment gaps in visual appearance, kinematic structure, and action spaces hinder effective knowledge transfer. Existing methods often decouple cross-embodiment knowledge alignment from robot policy learning, making it difficult for human manipulation knowledge to directly and fully contribute to robot action learning. To address this issue, we propose Nexus-VLA, a hybrid policy learning framework that enables cross-embodiment knowledge transfer through end-to-end human-robot joint training, allowing human manipulation experience to directly contribute to robot policy learning. We first introduce a hierarchical cross-embodiment semantic alignment paradigm that progressively establishes shared manipulation semantics from task intent to fine-grained interactions, enabling more complete use of the manipulation knowledge contained in human videos. Building on this hierarchy, we design a shared manipulation latent representation that jointly encodes multi-level shared knowledge into an internal representation directly used for continuous action generation, improving policy learning efficiency while effectively leveraging human knowledge. Across RoboCasa-GR1, OOD settings, and real-world robot experiments, Nexus-VLA achieves an 80.5% task success rate on RoboCasa-GR1 and demonstrates strong advantages in human-data utilization, learning efficiency, and cross-scenario generalization.

papers.title_en: Coarse3D: Controllable and Faithful Sparse Structure Generation for Image-to-3D
papers.authors: Gaige Wang, Bowen Pan, Hao Ren, Jiangjing Lyu, Chengfei Lyu
papers.evidence: 从未定姿图像生成与输入视图对齐的三维稀疏几何
papers.tldr: 三维原生生成通常先预测稀疏结构，其朝向和整体几何会影响后续细化；但现有方法方向控制困难，生成结构也容易偏离输入图像。Coarse3D提出首帧锚定的规范空间，并以双塔扩散变换器联合生成和前馈重建，再用空间先验引导注意力建立像素与体素的对应。实验表明，该方法显著提升稀疏结构质量，并持续改善最终三维生成表现。它可直接替换现有流程的粗生成阶段，为从任意未定姿图像生成可控且忠实的三维结构提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Coarse-to-fine 3D-native generation relies heavily on the first-stage sparse structure, which determines the global orientation and overall geometry for subsequent refinement. However, existing coarse generators suffer from two key limitations: their orientation is difficult to control due to ambiguous semantic canonicalization, and their structures are often inconsistent with input images due to weak 2D-3D grounding. We propose Coarse3D, a sparse-structure generation model that produces orientation-controllable and structurally faithful voxel geometry from arbitrary unposed images. Coarse3D introduces three designs: a first-frame anchored canonical space that aligns generation with the first input view while preserving object-centric normalization; a dual-tower DiT that couples generation with auxiliary feed-forward reconstruction to learn spatially grounded features; and spatial-prior guided attention that regularizes cross-attention with pixel-to-voxel correspondence. Coarse3D can directly replace the coarse stage of existing pipelines. Experiments show that it substantially improves sparse structure quality and consistently enhances final 3D generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

papers.title_en: GSExplorer: Interactive World Generation with a Persistent 3D Gaussian World State
papers.authors: Sicheng Yu, Liu Liu, Xinjie Wang, Xinjiang Wang, Taojun Ding, Wenhao Hu, Beizhen Zhao, Puxin Yan, Zhizhong Su, Hao Wang
papers.evidence: 以持久三维高斯世界状态支撑交互式生成与重建
papers.tldr: 交互式世界生成既要精确控制局部视角，也要在长程探索中维持场景一致；现有方法容易因引导信息不足和重复更新而累积误差。GSExplorer以持久化三维高斯世界状态提供多模态渲染条件，并用相对射线编码控制相机，将生成视频回灌至带一致性过滤和跨块优化的重建后端。实验中，它在单步与三步评测的综合表现均优于对比方法，单步相机控制得分达99.07，481帧往返探索也保持较强重访一致性。结果说明，持续维护可靠三维状态有助于稳定扩展交互式探索。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive world generation requires both accurate local control and stable scene consistency over long rollouts. Existing methods improve local generation through camera or geometry conditioning and extend historical context with memory mechanisms. However, long-horizon exploration remains challenging as target-view guidance becomes incomplete and inconsistencies accumulate across repeated scene updates. We present \textbf{GSExplorer}, a generation--reconstruction framework built around a persistent 3D Gaussian world state. At each step, the current 3DGS scene provides multimodal rendering conditions for a condition-driven video generator, while camera geometry is injected through a separate Relative Ray Encoding branch. Generated videos are then fed back to a SLAM-based reconstruction backend, where inconsistency filtering prevents conflicting content from corrupting the scene and cross-chunk bundle adjustment improves spatial alignment across generation steps. We further design a data-construction pipeline that reproduces realistic 3DGS degradation during scene extrapolation, yielding 293K training pairs of degraded multimodal renderings and real target videos. GSExplorer achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods on both single-step and three-step WorldScore evaluation, with strong camera control and consistency across both settings, including a Camera Control score of 99.07 in single-step extrapolation. On 481-frame leave-and-return rollouts, it also shows strong revisit consistency, demonstrating the value of maintaining a reliable 3D world state for continued exploration.

papers.title_en: UA-Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Depth Restoration for Material-Agnostic Object Manipulation
papers.authors: Rui Cao, Jia-Hui Pan, Yin Zhang, Qiwei Meng, Jiapeng Li, Gang Wang, Runsong Zhu, Wei Chen, Chi-Wing Fu, Jiangliu Wang, Yun-Hui Liu
papers.evidence: 恢复适用于机器人操作的度量深度图
papers.tldr: 消费级RGB-D相机面对透明、反光和半透明物体时常出现深度空洞、结构噪声与偏差，影响机器人抓取和操作。UA-Depth迭代联合细化深度与逐像素不确定性，以不确定性门控特征抑制不可靠线索，并借助冻结深度基础模型补全先验、通过两阶段MAD加权对数深度归一化校准尺度。作者构建涵盖多场景、材质和传感器的八数据集零样本基准，方法取得代表性基线中最佳平均排名，且在透明与反光物体数据上提升明显。利用预测不确定性还改善类别级六维位姿估计和六维抓取合成，推动材料无关的稳健操作。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation requires accurate metric depth, yet commodity RGB-D cameras often fail on non-Lambertian objects such as transparent, reflective, and translucent materials, producing holes, structured noise, and biased depth. Most restoration methods produce only a single depth map, treating noisy and reliable regions uniformly for downstream tasks while ignoring regional uncertainty. We present UA-Depth, an uncertainty-aware depth restoration framework that iteratively co-refines depth and pixel-wise uncertainty, and uses uncertainty-gated features to suppress unreliable cues for stable updates. To strengthen zero-shot behavior, UA-Depth leverages a frozen depth foundation model as a prior to initialize missing or unreliable depth, and applies two-stage MAD-weighted log-depth scale normalization to reduce outlier bias in relative-to-metric alignment. We introduce an eight-dataset zero-shot benchmark across diverse scenes, materials, and sensors. Across these benchmarks, UA-Depth achieves the best mean rank among representative baselines, with particularly strong gains on datasets dominated by transparent and reflective objects. Beyond depth metrics, we demonstrate downstream improvements in category-level 6D pose estimation and 6D grasp synthesis by exploiting the predicted uncertainty. \emph{Code, models, and data for training and evaluation will be released upon publication.}

papers.title_en: Leveraging 2D Foundation Priors for Generalized Category Discovery under Test-Time Adaptation in 3D LiDAR Segmentation
papers.authors: Hanqi Chen, Chaoqi Chen, Tian Ji, Hui Huang
papers.evidence: 面向自动驾驶的三维激光雷达语义分割及类别发现
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶场景持续变化且新类别不断出现，激光雷达语义分割需同时适应域偏移并发现未知类别；点云语义有限，使两项任务结合时容易出现特征坍塌。论文提出两阶段框架：先按几何密度聚合局部特征，并以全局类别原型一致性生成伪标签；再通过最优传输分组新类别，同时融合二维视觉基础模型语义以增强三维特征。跨合成到真实数据集的评测中，10个划分有9个取得最高总体mIoU，较最强复现基线最高提升12.21点。结果表明，二维先验与全局约束有助于提升域适应下类别发现的稳定性和分割性能。
papers.abstract_en: In autonomous driving, 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation is expected to adapt to evolving environments and recognize previously unseen categories, making generalized category discovery under test-time adaptation (GCD-TTA) an important problem. However, existing works treat GCD and TTA separately, while the limited semantic information in 3D point clouds makes GCD-TTA under domain shift more prone to feature collapse when combining GCD with TTA. To address this issue, we propose a two-stage framework for GCD-TTA in 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation. Specifically, in the first stage, we adaptively aggregate local 3D features according to geometric density variations and obtain reliable pseudo labels under a global class-wise prototype consistency constraint. In the second stage, we cast category discovery as an optimal transport assignment process for globally consistent grouping of novel categories. Meanwhile, semantic features from 2D vision foundation models are fused with 3D point cloud features to enrich 3D semantic information and promote a more separable feature space. Extensive experiments on Synth4D to SemanticKITTI, SynLiDAR to SemanticKITTI, and Synth4D to nuScenes demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our method achieves the best overall mIoU on 9 out of 10 benchmark splits and improves the overall mIoU by up to 12.21 points over the strongest re-implemented baseline.

papers.title_en: VLSplat: Vision-Language Guided Object-Centric 3D Gaussian Splatting via Scene Graph
papers.authors: Yuntae Jeon, Younho Jeon, Sujin Jin, Sungho Jo, Seunghee Park
papers.evidence: 通过物体中心语义提升三维场景表示与理解
papers.tldr: 三维高斯泼溅的语义表示有助于场景理解，但现有二维到三维提升方法主要依赖分割掩码，缺少对象级先验，学到的表示容易受局部证据影响。VLSplat引入视觉语言模型提供的对象语义先验，并通过对象组场景图组织高斯表示。其组内模块抑制语义噪声，组间模块从邻近对象组扩展结构相关的候选区域。室内场景实验表明，该方法提升了对象类别的语义一致性和结构完整性，为对象中心的三维语义建模提供了新的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Learning semantic representations for 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising direction for 3D scene understanding. However, existing 2D-to-3D semantic lifting approaches rely primarily on 2D segmentation supervision and lack object-level priors, causing the learned representation to be driven by local mask evidence rather than holistic object structure. In this paper, we present VLSplat, a vision-language guided approach for object-centric semantic lifting in 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method augments mask-based lifting with object-level semantic priors derived from vision-language models and refines Gaussian representations using an object-group scene graph. The refinement is performed through two language-guided modules: intra-group refinement suppresses semantic noise within object groups, while inter-group acquisition expands object support regions by incorporating structurally relevant candidates from neighboring groups. Extensive experiments on indoor scene datasets demonstrate that VLSplat improves the semantic consistency and structural completeness of object-level categories. Our code and models are available at https://vlsplat.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Queryable Gaussian View Index: Text Retrieval and Selective Camera Localization
papers.authors: Tianyu Xiong, Rui Li, Jiaqi Yang
papers.evidence: 从高斯场景资产及参考数据中选择性定位相机
papers.tldr: 现有高斯场景资产虽包含丰富视图与标定数据，却不便直接按文本查找地点，也难以对选定图像快速定位相机。QGVI建立可查询视图索引：文本路线将结构化描述与地点及已知位姿关联，图像路线用LoGS几何估计和查询关键点内点筛选定位。九个开发场景中，文本检索前一、前五联合成功率为58.3%和78.3%，图像定位在1米/2度阈值下达97.3%，文本查询中位耗时仅0.020秒。该方法无需在线渲染、视觉语言模型调用或场景专用位姿网络，为既有资产提供轻量检索与定位能力；语义成功与源相机恢复分别评估。
papers.abstract_en: We present Queryable Gaussian View Index (QGVI) for querying existing Gaussian scene assets and their associated calibrated reference data. Text-view retrieval and selective RGB camera localization return poses in the asset's coordinate frame. QGVI-T turns Gaussian-rendered views into a language-searchable index of scene locations, binding structured captions to known camera poses and place identifiers. Semantic and lexical retrieval select views from distinct places without online rendering, VLM calls, or a scene-specific pose network. The image route, QGVI-I, filters LoGS-based geometric estimates using distinct inlier query keypoints. It omits photometric refinement and preserves accepted pose coordinates. On nine development scenes, QGVI-T achieves 58.3% Top-1 and 78.3% Top-5 joint relevance-and-validity success, compared with 26.1% and 34.6% for our CityLoC reimplementation with refinement. QGVI-I achieves 97.3% scene-mean pose success at 1 m/2 degrees, with pooled false-acceptance and false-rejection rates of 0.707% and 1.142%. A paired cached evaluation retains all 1,775 initializer poses correct at this threshold. Recorded median text query latency is 0.020 s. Matched controls show competitive BM25 retrieval and slightly lower false acceptance for thresholded full LoGS; grid augmentation suggests modest gains on novel-view-derived descriptions. We report model-judged semantic success separately from source-camera recovery, with source-verified or estimated scales for geometric evaluation.

papers.title_en: VoxLution: Evolving Voxels for High-Fidelity 3D Scene Generation
papers.authors: Daoyi Gao, Xinyi Zhang, Alexey Bokhovkin, Lei Li, Angela Dai
papers.evidence: 以多分辨率体素变换器逐步生成三维场景几何
papers.tldr: 高分辨率室内场景对虚拟现实、空间计算和机器人仿真至关重要，但现有生成模型常得到过度平滑的几何。VoxLution先生成粗略空间布局，再以Transformer按局部块逐步细化稀疏体素，并用跨分辨率编码及相邻块边界信息维持结构连贯。其免训练、分辨率无关的标记方案将八个八分体紧凑编码为单个十进制数。在3D-FRONT与ScanNet++上，FPD和FID均大幅下降，且生成分辨率高于已有基线，为高保真三维室内场景生成提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution 3D indoor scene generation is crucial for immersive applications such as virtual reality, spatial computing, and robotics simulation. We introduce VoxLution, a coarse-to-fine transformer-based approach that generates high-fidelity indoor scenes with rich details, overcoming the overly smooth geometry typical of existing generative models. First, we generate a low-resolution spatial layout; then, based on this structural information, we progressively refine the scene geometry locally in chunks. Key to our approach is formulating 3D super-resolution as a sequence modeling problem over multi-resolution sparse voxel grids. To achieve this, we introduce a training-free, resolution-invariant tokenization scheme that compactly encodes the geometric information of eight octants into a single decimal number. We formulate the transformer sequence to include multiple resolutions, allowing the coarse layout to guide the generation of fine local details. To ensure coherence across local chunks, we incorporate adjacent chunk boundary information directly into the transformer sequencing. VoxLution achieves scene generation at a finer voxel resolution than existing baselines, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks with 59.6% lower FPD and 51.1% lower FID on 3D-FRONT, and 70.5% lower FPD and 73.8% lower FID on Scannet++.

papers.title_en: SemEllipsoid: Semantic-aware Shape Abstraction with Ellipsoid
papers.authors: Kuankuan Cheng, Haocheng Yuan, Changjian Li
papers.evidence: 将三维形状抽象为语义一致的几何部件
papers.tldr: 三维形状抽象以少量基本体近似模型，便于形状理解、分析与仿真；但传统方法重视几何保真，可能使基本体跨越语义部件边界，给部件级编辑和操控带来问题。SemEllipsoid以椭球为基本体，将语义线索纳入优化，通过可微投影、融合与评估度量语义偏差，并交替优化部件分配和椭球配置。实验在多个形状集合上验证其有效性，方法无需采集数据或训练网络，适用于不同类别并支持调整抽象层级。它使几何紧凑表示同时满足语义一致性，为下游任务提供更可靠的形状抽象。
papers.abstract_en: Representing 3D shapes using a set of primitives - known as shape abstraction - is an actively studied problem in computer graphics with wide applications in shape understanding, analysis, and simulation due to the compactness and computational efficiency of the primitive-based representation. Prior work has primarily focused on geometry-aware shape abstraction, where the objective is to approximate the input shape with a minimal set of primitives while preserving geometric fidelity. However, these methods often overlook semantic consistency, inevitably leading to primitives that span across multiple semantic parts. Such inconsistency can cause undesirable artifacts in downstream tasks such as part-level shape editing or manipulation. In this paper, we introduce a new task - semantic-aware shape abstraction, where the goal is to produce abstractions that are both geometrically faithful and semantically consistent, ensuring that each primitive adheres strictly to a single semantic part without crossing semantic boundaries. We propose SemEllipsoid, a novel method to address this problem using ellipsoidal primitives. The core idea is to inject semantic constraints into the primitive optimization process leveraging the availability of semantic cues from large-scale foundation models. We design a fully differentiable projection-blending-evaluation scheme to measure semantic divergence against input semantic masks, and formulate an alternating optimization strategy to iteratively solve for optimal semantic assignment and primitive configurations. Our method is non-learning-based, requiring no data collection or network training, and generalizes well to shapes from arbitrary categories. It also supports different levels of abstraction according to user demand. Extensive experiments and evaluations validate the effectiveness of our approach across several 3D shape collections.

papers.title_en: Text-Assisted Event Stream Visual Place Recognition via Multi-Scale Spatiotemporal Optimal Transport
papers.authors: Lan Chen, Xingxing Xiong, Xiao Wang, Ziyan Zhang, Zikang Yan, Yuanhao Zheng, Bo Jiang, Yonghong Tian
papers.evidence: 多尺度事件视觉地点识别可支持机器人环境感知与导航
papers.tldr: 低空经济应用关注利用事件相机进行视觉地点识别，其高动态范围、高时间分辨率和低能耗具有优势。然而，事件流结构空间信息稀疏，已有文本辅助方法仍难以充分编码事件特征并与文本语义对齐。本文提出MSTOT-EPR，以视觉和文本编码器提取特征，通过最优传输对齐，并借助跨模态瓶颈模块融合两种模态；多尺度空间和帧间时间最优传输进一步挖掘时空信息。在NYC-Event-VPR与EPRBench上的实验验证了方法有效性，为事件相机地点识别提供了新的建模方案。
papers.abstract_en: Benefiting from the high dynamic range, high temporal resolution, and low energy consumption of event cameras, low-altitude economic research leveraging event cameras has become a popular topic. Several existing attempts introduce natural-language descriptions into visual place recognition (VPR) to mitigate the sparsity of structural spatial information inherent to event cameras. Nevertheless, these methods still fail to fully address two core challenges: effectively encoding event streams and semantically aligning event streams with text. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale spatial-temporal optimal transport approach, MSTOT-EPR, to address these challenges. Specifically, given event streams and scene text information, we first adopt a visual encoder and a text encoder to extract respective feature representations. We then apply optimal-transport constraints to achieve cross-modal alignment. We then design a cross-modal bottleneck fusion module to further fuse bimodal features. Furthermore, we develop multi-scale spatial optimal transport and inter-frame temporal optimal transport modules to mine high-quality spatial-temporal event features for scene recognition. Extensive experiments on the NYC-Event-VPR and EPRBench datasets fully validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework for event-based VPR. The source code of this paper will be released upon acceptance.

papers.title_en: Lie Routing Vision Language Models for View-Robust 3D Understanding
papers.authors: Jingjun Yi, Chen Hu, Qi Bi, Hao Zheng, Huimin Huang, Yongkang, Wei Ji, Yawen Huang, Xian Wu, Yefeng Zheng
papers.evidence: 利用VGGT几何令牌适配多视角三维视觉表征
papers.tldr: 多模态大语言模型已能从多视角图像理解三维场景，但相同物体和查询会因相机视角变化产生语义漂移，导致目标相关回答不一致。为此，论文提出LieVLM，利用几何令牌预测局部旋转及通道路由，在三维子空间中通过Padé–Cayley映射调整视觉特征，并以门控方式保留原有语义与空间信息。在三维描述、定位、检测和空间推理任务上，该方法相较加性融合持续提升，且适用于不同训练规模和骨干。结果表明，几何条件化的旋转路由有助于提升跨视角三维理解的稳定性。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in 3D scene understanding from multi-view RGB observations. Yet a fixed object and query can elicit inconsistent target-related responses across camera viewpoints, a phenomenon we characterize as viewpoint-induced semantic drift. We introduce LieVLM, a Lie routing framework for view-robust 3D understanding. Motivated by the rotational component of viewpoint change, Lie routing adapts visual representations by applying local $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ transformations to projected features within learned three-dimensional subspaces. Geometry tokens extracted by VGGT predict local rotation parameters and channel-wise routing coefficients. A closed-form Padé--Cayley map transforms projected visual features, whose identity-relative corrections are projected back and gated into the original visual and geometry features. This design retains the pretrained semantic and direct spatial context while learning view-dependent feature adjustments. Experiments on 3D captioning, grounding, detection, and spatial reasoning show consistent improvements over additive fusion across training scales and backbones. Controlled ablations examine the roles of geometric conditioning and transformation structure. Viewpoint analyses further reveal systematic variation in the predicted routing states alongside more localized target responses and stronger task performance across viewpoint changes.
